mapper.select: select av.id, av.name, av.attr_key_id, ak.name attr_key_name from lease.attr_value av left join lease.attr_key ak on ak.id = av.attr_key_id and ak.is_deleted = 0 where av.is_deleted = 0 and av.id in (select attr_value_id from lease.room_attr_value where is_deleted = 0 and room_id = #{id})
